question: Which Sultan used the Banjaras to transport grain to city markets?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alauddin Khalji**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alauddin Khalji** used the **Banjaras** to transport grain from the countryside to the **city markets**.
 
• The Banjaras were a community of **caravan traders and transporters** who carried food grains and other goods over long distances.
 
• Alauddin Khalji introduced strict **market control measures** in Delhi and ensured a regular supply of grain to the markets.
 
• The Banjaras played an important role in transporting grain to Delhi, helping the Sultan maintain **stable and low prices**.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Option 2 – Alauddin Khalji.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Alauddin Khalji (1296–1316):** Famous for his market-control policy, including regulation of prices and ensuring adequate supplies of essential commodities.
 
• **Banjaras:** Important transporters and traders who moved grain and other commodities using pack animals and caravans.
 
• The supply of grain by Banjaras was particularly important for maintaining the functioning of **Delhi's regulated markets**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Alauddin Khalji → Market Control System**
 
• **Banjaras → Transported grain to city markets**
 
• **Objective → Ensure adequate grain supply and control prices**
